content: Enterprise shelf audit apps (ShelfAlign, FORM/GoSpotCheck, Planofy, Tevian, Asseco RIR) share table stakes: guided mobile photo capture, compare capture vs approved planogram/baseline, instant compliance score, visual highlighting of missing/misplaced/wrong-facing SKUs, audit history, offline or sync-when-connected, and in-store actionable feedback within seconds. Store-employee apps emphasize fixed-fixture workflows and speed (Planofy claims 10-15 min manual to ~20 sec photo audit).
